summary_1line: Chitrasena’s Gandharvas rout the Kauravas, capture Duryodhana and others, and Bhima mocks them until Yudhishthira insists their family honor requires rescue.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Gandharva king Chitrasena leaps forward and seizes the fallen Duryodhana beside the shattered remains of his chariot on the battlefield.
Hundreds of Gandharvas swarm Karna’s chariot, hacking apart its horses, flagstaff, wheels, and yoke until it collapses into fragments.
Bhima laughs with biting sarcasm before the anxious Kuru attendants while Yudhishthira raises a hand to stop his cruel words.
